top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a single, statable invention, trapping many neutral atoms at a magic wavelength so the differential light shift cancels, credited to Katori (concept and first realisations) and Ye (record accuracy and many-body clock work) without a gap in the core. It is reproduced across laboratories and species at the 1e-18 level and underpins geodesy and constant-variation and dark-matter tests. The 2005 and 2012 overlap is real but is met by wording the citation around magic-wavelength lattice trapping. P002 is mature and conceptually broad but leaves the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang HgTe proposal uncredited, so I rank it second, above no award.
